api.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.

lock.title: This value comes from the {env} environment variable and can't be changed here.

auth.setupDesc: Create the admin login. Whoever opens this page first sets the password, so do it now.
auth.usernameLength: The username must be 3 to 64 characters long.
auth.passwordLength: The password must be at least 8 characters long.
auth.setupTakenDesc: Sign in with that account instead.
auth.sessionEnded: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.

pw.hint: At least 8 characters. A few random words work well.

shell.signOutDirtyDesc: Your unsaved changes will be lost.
shell.restartTitle: Restart Tamamo to apply the new listen addresses
shell.restartDesc: Tamamo is still listening on the old addresses. New: proxy {proxy}, admin {admin}.

savebar.hint: Nothing changes for visitors until you save.
savebar.discardDesc: Everything you changed since the last save will be undone.

backTitle.page: Use the global checking page for {name}?

backDesc.page: This site's own checking page is dropped when you save. You can still discard this before saving.

scope.globalInfo: Used by the default site and by every site without its own.
scope.noticeTitle: This site uses the global settings

noticeDesc.protection: {name} follows the global protection settings. Customize them to give this site its own copy, starting from the current global ones.
noticeDesc.rules: {name} follows the global rules. Customize them to give this site its own copy, starting from the current global ones.
noticeDesc.page: {name} follows the global checking page. Customize it to give this site its own copy, starting from the current global one.

customized.protection: {name} now has its own protection settings
customized.page: {name} now has its own checking page

overview.desc: What Tamamo did for your sites in the last 24 hours.
overview.offDesc: Tamamo is passing every request straight to {target} without checks.
overview.onDescSites_one: Requests to {target} and {n} other site go through {rules}.
overview.onDescSites_other: Requests to {target} and {n} other sites go through {rules}.

fallback.allow: Anything no rule matches is let through.
fallback.challenge: Anything no rule matches is checked.
fallback.block: Anything no rule matches is blocked.

overview.statsOffDesc: Turn them on under {link} to see traffic here.

day.title: Last 24 hours
day.desc: Requests per hour, by what Tamamo did with them.
day.chart: Requests per hour over the last 24 hours

week.title: Last 7 days
week.chart: Requests per day over the last 7 days

overview.topAgentsDesc: User agents that got checked or refused.
overview.topPathsDesc: Most requested paths that got checked or blocked.
overview.noTrafficDesc: Point your visitors at Tamamo (listening on {listen}) and requests will show up here within seconds.

activity.desc: The most recent checks, solves, failures and blocks. Updates every 10 seconds.
activity.resetDesc: Counters, charts and the recent events list are cleared. This cannot be undone.
activity.statsOffDesc: Turn them on under Server to record events.
activity.noMatchDesc: Try another kind or clear the search.
activity.noneDesc: Events appear here when Tamamo challenges, verifies or blocks someone. Requests that are simply let through are only counted.

1.name: Barely there
1.desc: Stops only the laziest scripts. Instant for everyone.

2.name: Very light
2.desc: Unnoticeable for people, a small cost for bots.

3.name: Light
3.desc: Still instant on phones. Good for sites with lots of mobile visitors.

4.name: Balanced
4.desc: Recommended. A blink on laptops, a moment on phones.

5.name: Firm
5.desc: Noticeable on older phones. Good when bots keep getting through.

6.name: Strong
6.desc: Phones wait several seconds or more. Use for short attacks only.

7.name: Very strong
7.desc: Minutes on phones. Only for emergencies.

8.name: Extreme
8.desc: Can take a very long time on any device. Almost nobody will wait.

protection.desc: How hard the check is, who has to take it, and how long a pass lasts.
protection.enabledDesc: When off, Tamamo is a plain reverse proxy: every request goes straight through and no rule runs.
protection.difficultyDesc: How much work a browser has to do to prove it is not a bot. Higher numbers stop more bots but make phones wait longer.
protection.vary: Real times vary a lot: some visitors get lucky, some wait two or three times longer.
protection.fallbackTitle: What happens to requests no rule matches?
protection.fallbackDesc: Rules are checked first. This is the fallback for everything else.

fallback.allow: Let it through. Only requests that match a Check or Block rule are stopped.
fallback.challenge: Show the checking page. Safest, but API clients and feeds will fail.
fallback.block: Refuse it. Only what your Allow and Check rules name gets in.

protection.passesDesc: After solving the check, a visitor gets a signed cookie (a "pass") and is not asked again until it expires.
protection.passHoursHelp: Currently {current}. Shorter means more checks; longer means a stolen pass works longer.
protection.challengeMinutes: Visitors must finish the check within
protection.challengeMinutesHelp: A checking page left open longer than this has to start over.
protection.bindIp: Tie the pass to the visitor’s network
protection.bindIpDesc: A pass stops working if it is used from a different network (/24 for IPv4, /64 for IPv6). Stops pass sharing, but people on mobile data may be asked again.
protection.bindUa: Tie the pass to the browser
protection.bindUaDesc: A pass only works with the browser (user agent) that earned it. Browser updates make visitors check again.
protection.cookieNameHelp: Letters, digits, `-` and `_`. Changing it signs every visitor out.
protection.cookieDomainHelp: Leave empty for the exact host. Set to `example.com` to share one pass across its subdomains.
protection.maxFailuresHelp: Visitors who submit more wrong answers than this get blocked for a minute. 0 turns the limit off.

rules.descShort: Rules decide what happens to each request.
rules.desc: Rules decide what happens to each request. They are checked top to bottom and the first match wins; anything no rule matches gets the default action from Protection.
rules.restoreDesc: Replace all rules with the ones Tamamo ships with.
rules.restoreConfirmDesc: All your current rules are replaced. You can still discard this before saving.
rules.syntaxDesc: Use `*` as a wildcard (`/api/*`, `*GPTBot*`). Start with `re:` for a regular expression (`re:^/(admin|login)`). Paths and hosts must match completely; user agents and headers match anywhere. Matching is case-insensitive except for paths. Inside one rule every filled-in condition must match; within a condition any line may match.
rules.noneDesc: Every request gets the default action ({action}). Add a rule or a preset to get started.
rules.addedBottom: It is at the bottom of the list. Move it up if it should win earlier.
rules.addedTop: It is at the top of the list, so it wins over the others.
rules.deleteDesc: The rule is removed from the list. You can still discard this before saving.
rules.name: Name
rules.notePlaceholder: Why this rule exists (only you see this)
rules.conditionsHelp: Leave a box empty to ignore it. A rule with no conditions matches every request.
rules.pathsHelp: One per line. Must match the whole path.
rules.agentsHelp: One per line. Matches anywhere in the User-Agent.
rules.ipsHelp: One per line. Single addresses or CIDR ranges.
rules.hostsHelp: Must match the whole host name.
rules.headersHelp: The header must be present and its value must match the pattern.

rulesFile.pageDesc: All rules — global and per site — as YAML, exactly as they are stored in tamamo.yaml. Handy for bulk edits, copying rules between servers and keeping them in version control.
rulesFile.dirtyDesc: The file editor shows the saved rules. Your unsaved changes are not in it, and saving the file reloads every setting, which throws those changes away. Save or discard them first to be safe.
rulesFile.leaveDesc: Your changes to the file haven't been saved and will be lost.
rulesFile.title: Rules as YAML
rulesFile.revertDesc: The editor goes back to the file as it was last loaded.
rulesFile.savedDesc: Tamamo is using the new rules now.
rulesFile.keys: Tab inserts two spaces, Shift+Tab removes them. Press Esc, then Tab, to move out of the editor. {save} saves.
rulesFile.autoTitle: You don't need this page to edit rules
rulesFile.autoDesc: The rules live in {path}. Tamamo reloads that file automatically whenever it changes on disk, so you can edit it with any text editor — and switch the admin UI off at any time.
rulesFile.formatDesc: Two top-level lists: `rules` holds the rules for the default site and every site without its own rules; `sites` holds one entry per site, identified by its `name`, with that site’s `rules`.
rulesFile.formatKeys: Each rule can use `id`, `name`, `enabled`, `action` (`allow`, `challenge` or `block`), `difficulty`, `note`, `paths`, `user_agents`, `ips`, `methods`, `hosts` and `headers` (a map of header name to pattern).
rulesFile.formatAlternative: Policy files written for similar tools also work: `path_regex`, `user_agent_regex` and the actions `ALLOW`, `DENY` and `CHALLENGE` are understood.

tester.title: Rule tester
tester.desc: Describe a request and see which rule catches it.
tester.savedOnly: The tester uses your saved rules
tester.savedOnlyDesc: You have unsaved changes. Save them first to test the new rules.
tester.pathNote: Paths are normalized before matching, just like for real visitors: `/a/../b` is checked as `/b`.

verdict.allow: This request would be let through.
verdict.challenge: This request would be shown the checking page at difficulty {n}.

modules.desc: Modules extend Tamamo: extra checks that run before your rules, and add-ons for the checking page.
modules.orderDesc: Modules run top to bottom, before any rule. The first module that makes a decision (allow, check or block) wins; the rest and the rules are skipped.
modules.loadError: Couldn't load the list of available modules
modules.noneDesc: Tamamo works fine without them. Add one to ask your own service about requests or to extend the checking page.
modules.deleteDesc: The module is removed from the list. You can still discard this before saving.

typeDesc.go: A module compiled into this Tamamo build.
typeDesc.webhook: Tamamo asks your HTTP endpoint about each request.
typeDesc.page: Your own HTML, CSS or JavaScript on the checking page.

modules.addDesc: It is added at the bottom of the list and takes effect when you save.
modules.noBuiltinDesc: This Tamamo build doesn't include any Go modules. Use a webhook instead.
modules.name: Name
modules.nameHelp: Letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores. Shown in Activity and in the logs.
modules.urlHelp: Tamamo POSTs a short JSON description of each request here and expects a decision back.
modules.onErrorHelp: What happens when the module errors or doesn't answer in time.
modules.cacheHelp: Optional. Reuse an answer for the same visitor for this long. 0 = ask every time.
modules.sitesHelp: Leave all unticked to use the module on every site.
modules.pageFilesHelp: Tamamo picks up these files when present: {files}.
modules.pageDesc: Folders found in {dir}. Each one can be added as a module.
modules.pageHow: To add one, create a folder such as {path} with any of these files:

file.head: added to the page's <head>
file.body: added at the end of the page's <body>

modules.pageReload: Open this screen again to see new folders.
modules.pageMissingDesc: Tamamo looks for it in {dir}. Until it exists, the module does nothing.
modules.goMissingDesc: This Tamamo build has no module with that name, so it is skipped.
modules.errName: Give the webhook a name of up to 64 characters.
modules.errUrl: The webhook URL must start with http:// or https://.
modules.errTimeout: The timeout must be between 1 and 10,000 ms.
modules.errDuplicate: There is already a module called “{name}”.

page.desc: What visitors see while their browser proves it is not a bot. Changes show in the preview right away; visitors see them after you save.
page.descShort: What visitors see while their browser proves it is not a bot.
page.previewHelp: The preview is simulated: it never runs a real check or sends anything. Click a text field to jump to its state.
page.resetDesc: Texts, colors, layout and custom CSS go back to the defaults. Uploaded images stay (reset them one by one in the Mascot tab). You can still discard this before saving.
page.creditTitle: The 'Protected by Tamamo' credit is always shown and can't be removed or hidden.
page.creditDesc: You can choose where it sits (Layout tab), and it follows your colors.

lang.title: Languages
lang.desc: Write the page in several languages. Empty fields in a translation use the main text.
lang.languageAuto: Automatic — the visitor's language when available
lang.languageHelp: Automatic picks a translation from the visitor's browser languages and falls back to the main language.
lang.addDesc: Ready-made texts are filled in for Russian and Ukrainian; other languages start empty and fall back to the main text.
lang.errCode: Use a language code like de, fr or pt-br.
lang.addedBuiltin: Filled in with Tamamo's built-in texts. Save to apply.
lang.addedEmpty: Fill in the texts, then save. Empty fields use the main text.
lang.removeDesc: Its texts are deleted when you save. Visitors who prefer it see the main language.
lang.fallbackDesc: Grayed-out placeholders show the main text. Leave a field empty to use it.

text.title: Browser tab title
text.langHelp: The main language, for screen readers and translation tools, e.g. `en`, `de`, `pt-BR`.
text.heading: Heading
text.hostHelp: `{host}` is replaced with the host name the visitor opened, such as blog.example.com.
text.checkingDesc: Shown while the browser works on the check.
text.successDesc: Shown for a moment after the check passes.
text.deniedDesc: Shown when a Block rule refuses the request.
text.errorDesc: Shown when the check fails or the browser is not supported.
text.continueHelp: Shown when automatic redirect is off.

labels.title: Other wording
labels.desc: Small labels and messages on the checking page. Empty fields use the text shown grayed out.
labels.solver_failedHelp: `{error}` is replaced with the technical error.
labels.server_rejectedHelp: `{status}` is replaced with the HTTP status code.
labels.challenge_wrong_client: Check from another browser or network

page.presetsHelp: A preset fills both palettes below. You can fine-tune any color afterwards.
page.palettesDesc: Light is used on light devices, dark on dark devices (or always, depending on the mode above).

font.label: Font
font.customHelp: Names of fonts installed on visitors’ devices. Web fonts are not loaded. Letters, quotes, commas and dashes only.

align.label: Text alignment
align.leftDesc: Text lines up on the left.

layout.cardDesc: A box in the middle of the page.
layout.splitDesc: Mascot on one side, text on the other.

creditAlign.label: Position of the 'Protected by Tamamo' credit

mascot.mirrorDesc: Flip the image so the mascot faces the other way.

page.imagesDesc: Uploads take effect immediately, without saving: PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP up to 4 MB. Transparent PNGs look best.

slot.tooLargeDesc: Images can be at most 4 MB.
slot.resetTitle: Go back to the default image

bg.noImageDesc: Upload one below; until then the page uses the plain background color.
bg.dimHelp: Darkens the image so the text stays readable.

progress.title: Progress
progress.label: Progress indicator
progress.rateDesc: How fast the browser is working, e.g. “1.2 M hashes/s”.
progress.percentDesc: Proof-of-work has no real progress; this is an estimate that can pass 100%.

timing.title: Timing
timing.min: Show the checking page for at least
timing.minHelp: Stops the page from flashing past on fast devices.
timing.delayHelp: How long the success message stays before moving on.
timing.autoDesc: When off, visitors press the Continue button after the check.
timing.animationsDesc: Visitors who ask their device for reduced motion never see animations.

css.help: Added after Tamamo’s own styles. Applies to every state.
css.desc: For anything the other tabs can’t do.
css.errCredit: Custom CSS can't target the credit line (the word 'credit' is not allowed).
css.targetsDesc: The page’s main classes and CSS variables. Overriding a variable on :root is usually easiest.

sites.desc: Protect several websites with one Tamamo. A site is picked by the host name visitors use, and can have its own protection settings, rules and checking page.
sites.defaultDesc: Serves every host name that no other site claims. Uses the global settings.
sites.noTraffic: No traffic in the last 24 hours.
sites.deleteDesc: Its host names fall back to the default site and its own settings are removed. You can still discard this before saving.
sites.ownOn: This site has its own copy.
sites.ownOff: Off: follows the global settings. Turning it on starts from a copy of them.

useGlobalDesc.protection: This site's own protection settings are dropped when you save.
useGlobalDesc.rules: This site's own rules are dropped when you save.
useGlobalDesc.page: This site's own checking page is dropped when you save.

sites.name: Name
sites.upstreamHelp: Optional. Empty uses the global upstream. Also leave it empty when nginx sends verified traffic to the app itself (auth_request).
sites.hostsHelp: One per line. `*.example.com` matches every subdomain. Exact names win over wildcards.
sites.none: Only the default site so far
sites.noneDesc: Add a site when you protect more than one domain, or when one of them needs different rules or a different checking page.

nginx.copyErrorDesc: Select the text and copy it by hand.
nginx.explainAuth: nginx asks Tamamo about each request (`auth_request`) and proxies allowed ones to your app itself. Tamamo only renders the checking page. The site needs no upstream in Tamamo.
nginx.explainProxy: nginx sends everything to Tamamo, which forwards verified visitors to {upstream}.
nginx.ipChangedDesc: Source: X-Real-IP, trusted proxy 127.0.0.1. Save to apply; adjust the proxy address under Server if nginx runs elsewhere.
nginx.ipTitle: Let Tamamo see real visitor IPs
nginx.ipDesc: Under Server, set the client IP source to `x-real-ip` and add nginx’s address to the trusted proxies.
nginx.catchAll: `server_name _` catches every host. Replace it with your domain names.
nginx.title: Use {name} with nginx
nginx.titleDefault: Use the default site with nginx
nginx.desc: Paste this into your nginx site config, adjust ports and TLS, then reload nginx.

server.desc: Where Tamamo sends traffic, and how it sees visitors.
server.upstreamDesc: Where verified visitors are sent. Sites without their own upstream (see Sites) use this one too.
server.preserveHostDesc: Pass the host the visitor asked for to the upstream. Turn off if your upstream expects its own name.
server.skipVerifyDesc: Only for upstreams with self-signed certificates on a network you trust. Anyone in between could read the traffic.
server.ipDesc: Rules, rate limits and passes rely on the visitor’s IP address.
server.ipSourceLabel: Where the visitor IP comes from

ipSourceHelp.remote: Use the address of whoever connects to Tamamo. Right when visitors connect directly.
ipSourceHelp.x-forwarded-for: Use the X-Forwarded-For header set by your reverse proxy (nginx, Caddy, Traefik, a load balancer).
ipSourceHelp.x-real-ip: Use the X-Real-IP header set by your reverse proxy (common with nginx).
ipSourceHelp.cf-connecting-ip: Use the CF-Connecting-IP header that Cloudflare adds.

server.proxiesTrusted: Headers are only trusted from the proxies below
server.proxiesWarn: Anyone can send this header. Without trusted proxies, a bot could pretend to be any IP address, including ones you allow.
server.proxiesHelp: One IP address or CIDR range per line. The header is only believed when the connection comes from one of these.
server.listenDesc: Changes here need a restart of Tamamo to take effect.

domains.title: Admin domains
domains.desc: Answer admin UI requests only for these host names. Everything else gets “not found”.
domains.label: Domains
domains.help: One per line, e.g. `admin.example.com`. Leave empty to answer on any host name.
domains.warnTitle: A wrong value locks you out
domains.warnDesc: If the list doesn't include the name you use to open this page, the admin UI stops answering you. To get back in, fix `admin.domains` in {file} or set {env}, then restart Tamamo.
domains.lockoutDesc: You opened this page as {host}, which is not in the list. After saving, the admin UI stops answering here.

server.statsEnabledDesc: Counts and recent events, saved in tamamo.db in the data folder. Nothing is sent anywhere.
server.storeIpsDesc: Show visitor IPs in Activity. Turn off if you prefer not to keep them in tamamo.db.

security.desc: Your admin login and the keys that protect visitors.
security.loginDesc: Change the username, the password, or both.
security.keepHint: Leave the new password empty to keep the current one.
security.passwordLength: The new password must be at least 8 characters long.
security.passwordMismatch: The two new passwords don't match.
security.nothing: Change the username or enter a new password first.
security.needCurrent: Enter your current password to confirm.
security.updatedDesc: Other signed-in sessions were signed out.
security.sessionHoursHelp: Applies to new sign-ins. Sessions are kept in memory, so restarting Tamamo signs you out.
security.cookieNote: Your session lives in a secure, HttpOnly cookie that scripts on this page can't read.
security.secretDesc: Tamamo signs every visitor pass with a secret key. Rotate it if you think it leaked, or to make everyone check again.
security.rotateDesc: This signs every visitor out: everyone has to pass the check again, and checking pages that are open right now will fail once and retry. Your admin session is not affected.
security.rotatedDesc: All visitor passes are now invalid.
security.disableCardDesc: For locked-down servers: Tamamo keeps running with the saved settings, and nobody can change them from the web.
security.disableDesc: Tamamo keeps protecting your site with the current settings, but this page stops working right away.
security.howBack: To turn it back on later:
security.offDesc: Tamamo is still protecting your site.
security.turnOnHelp: To turn it back on, set {enabled} under {admin} in {file} or the environment variable {env}, then restart Tamamo.
security.disableError: Couldn't turn off the admin UI
security.lockedTitle: The admin UI is switched on by {env}
security.lockedDesc: Remove the {env} environment variable (or set it to false) and restart Tamamo instead.

about.mascotAlt: Tamamo, the fox-eared mascot, holding a magnifying glass
about.intro: A small reverse proxy that asks browsers to solve a short proof-of-work puzzle before they reach your site. People barely notice; scrapers pay for every page.
about.creditsTamamo: Tamamo and its fox-eared mascot are made with care for people who run their own small websites.
about.creditsIcons: Interface icons from Lucide. This admin works fully offline and loads nothing from other sites.
about.mascotDesc: Three poses, one for each state of the checking page. Replace them under Checking page → Mascot & images.
about.languagesDesc: This interface is available in the languages below. More languages are added in the tamamo_webui source and need a rebuild of the web UI container.

settings.desc: Preferences for this admin panel. Tamamo's own settings are on the other pages.
settings.interfaceDesc: The language of this admin panel. Your choice is remembered in this browser.
